name: GAN356 i Carry 4 3x3 (Minions Edition)
description: The GAN356 i Carry 4 3x3 (Minions Edition) is a vibrant collaboration between GANCUBE and Illumination's Minions, blending top-tier smart cube technology with a playful, iconic aesthetic. This limited-edition puzzle is built on the high-performance i Carry 4 platform, offering a premium speedcubing experience for collectors and tech-focused cubers alike.
